title: Jementah Civil War
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Jementah Civil War", at revision 1381758666, opens: "The Jementah Civil War broke out in 1879 in Jementah in northern Johor when Tengku Alam Shah, the heir of late Sultan Ali of the autonomous principality of Muar refused to surrender the principality to the central administration of Abu Bakar, the then Maharaja of Johor." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q6177105, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1879 conflict in Muar, Malaysia". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
